questions.text: एक प्रारूपिक पुष्पी पादप में निषेचन के उपरांत बीजाण्ड का वह भाग जो बीज के संरक्षात्मक आवरण में विकसित होता है, वह है :
questions.text_english: The part of the ovule that develops into protective coats of a seed after fertilization in a typical flowering plant is:
questions.solution: After the process of fertilization in a typical flowering plant, the integuments of the ovule undergo significant structural changes and harden to develop into the protective seed coats, which are known as the testa and tegmen.
questions.solution_hindi: एक प्रारूपिक पुष्पी पादप में निषेचन के उपरांत, बीजाण्ड के अध्यावरण (integuments) कठोर होकर बीज के संरक्षात्मक आवरण (बीजावरण) का निर्माण करते हैं, जिन्हें टेस्टा और टेगमेन कहा जाता है।

questions.text: एक डीएनए खण्ड में 2000 न्यूक्लिओटाइड्स हैं, जिनमें से 140 ऐडेनीन हैं। इस डीएनए खण्ड में कितने क्षारकों में तीन (ट्रिपल) हाइड्रोजन आबंध होंगे ?
questions.text_english: A DNA fragment has 2000 nucleotides, out of which 140 are Adenine. How many bases does this DNA segment possess that have triple hydrogen bonds between them?
questions.solution: According to Chargaff's rule, the number of Adenine (A) molecules is equal to Thymine (T). Since Adenine is 140, Thymine is also 140, making a total of 280 A-T bases. Out of 2000 nucleotides, the remaining 1720 nucleotides must be Guanine (G) and Cytosine (C). Because G pairs with C using three hydrogen bonds, there are 1720 bases in this DNA segment that possess triple hydrogen bonds between them.
questions.solution_hindi: चारगाफ के नियम के अनुसार, एडेनीन (A) की संख्या थाइमिन (T) के बराबर होती है। चूँकि एडेनीन 140 है, इसलिए थाइमिन भी 140 होगा। A और T की कुल संख्या 280 है। 2000 में से शेष 1720 न्यूक्लियोटाइड्स गुआनीन (G) और साइटोसिन (C) होंगे। G और C के बीच तीन हाइड्रोजन आबंध होते हैं, इसलिए ऐसे क्षारकों की संख्या 1720 होगी।

questions.text: इंग्लैंड में 1850 के दशक के दौरान औद्योगीकरण युग शुरू होने से पूर्व प्राकृतिक वरण के अनुमानित प्रभाव के कारण गहरे पंख वाले शलभों की संख्या, श्वेत पंख वाले शलभों की अपेक्षा :
questions.text_english: During the 1850s in the pre-industrialisation era in England, the expected effect of natural selection on the number of dark-winged moths as compared to white-winged moths was:
questions.solution: In the pre-industrialisation era, tree trunks were covered with light-coloured lichens. Against this light background, the white-winged moths were well camouflaged from predators, while the dark-winged moths were easily spotted and eaten. Therefore, due to natural selection, the dark-winged moths were significantly less in number compared to the white-winged moths.
questions.solution_hindi: औद्योगीकरण से पूर्व के युग में, पेड़ों के तने हल्के रंग के लाइकेन से ढके हुए थे। इस हल्के रंग की पृष्ठभूमि में, श्वेत पंख वाले शलभ शिकारियों से सुरक्षित रहते थे, जबकि गहरे रंग वाले शलभ आसानी से देखे जाते थे और उनका शिकार हो जाता था। अतः प्राकृतिक वरण के कारण गहरे पंख वाले शलभों की संख्या कम थी।

questions.text: निम्नलिखित पुष्पी पादपों में से किस पौधे में अंड कोशिका के निषेचन के बिना ही बीज में अनेक भ्रूण बन जाते हैं ?
questions.text_english: In which one of the following floral plants are many embryos formed in the seeds without fertilisation of the egg cell?
questions.solution: In Citrus plants, the phenomenon of polyembryony is commonly observed. Here, some of the maternal sporophytic cells like the nucellar cells surrounding the embryo sac start dividing, protrude into the embryo sac, and develop into multiple embryos without the fertilization of the egg cell.
questions.solution_hindi: सिट्रस (निम्बु-वंश) के पौधों में बहुभ्रूणता (polyembryony) पाई जाती है। इनमें बीजाण्डकाय (nucellus) की कोशिकाएँ विभाजित होकर भ्रूण-कोष में प्रवेश कर जाती हैं और निषेचन के बिना ही बीज में अनेक भ्रूण बना लेती हैं।

questions.text: स्नेपड्रेगन के गुलाबी पुष्पों वाले पौधे का स्नेपड्रेगन के श्वेत पुष्पों वाले पौधे के साथ संकरण कराया गया । संतति के फीनोटाइप का अनुमानित प्रतिशत है :
questions.text_english: A Snapdragon plant bearing pink colour flowers is crossed with a Snapdragon plant bearing white colour flowers. The expected phenotypic percentage of the offspring is :
questions.solution: In Snapdragon, flower colour shows incomplete dominance. Pink flowers are heterozygous (Rr) and white flowers are homozygous recessive (rr). When a pink flowered plant (Rr) is crossed with a white flowered plant (rr), the offspring produced will have the genotypes Rr and rr in a 1:1 ratio. Therefore, the phenotypic percentage of the offspring will be exactly 50% Pink and 50% White.
questions.solution_hindi: स्नेपड्रेगन में अपूर्ण प्रभाविता (incomplete dominance) पाई जाती है। गुलाबी पुष्प विषमयुग्मजी (Rr) होते हैं और श्वेत पुष्प समयुग्मजी अप्रभावी (rr) होते हैं। जब गुलाबी (Rr) का संकरण श्वेत (rr) से कराया जाता है, तो संतति में Rr और rr 1:1 के अनुपात में प्राप्त होते हैं। अतः 50% गुलाबी और 50% श्वेत पुष्प प्राप्त होंगे।

questions.text: किस गुणसूत्री (क्रोमोसोमी) विकार में व्यक्ति ऊँचे कद के साथ स्त्रैण लक्षण वाला होगा ?
questions.text_english: In which of the given chromosomal disorders does the individual have tall stature with feminised character?
questions.solution: Klinefelter's syndrome is a chromosomal disorder caused by the presence of an additional copy of the X chromosome, resulting in a karyotype of 47, XXY. Such an individual has an overall masculine development and a tall stature, but the feminine development is also expressed in the form of features like breast development (gynaecomastia).
questions.solution_hindi: क्लाइनेफेल्टर सिंड्रोम (Klinefelter's syndrome) एक गुणसूत्री विकार है जो एक अतिरिक्त X गुणसूत्र की उपस्थिति (47, XXY) के कारण होता है। इस विकार से पीड़ित व्यक्ति का कद ऊँचा होता है और उसमें स्त्रैण लक्षण जैसे कि स्तनों का विकास (gynaecomastia) दिखाई देता है।

questions.text: रासायनिक विकासवाद के समर्थन हेतु एस. एल. मिलर ने 1953 में एक बंद फ्लास्क में ऐसी परिस्थितियाँ उत्पन्न कीं जिसमें अंतर्विष्ट थे :
questions.text_english: S.L. Miller in 1953, to support the theory of chemical evolution, created conditions in the closed flask that included :

options.A: CH3, O2, NH3, H2O वाष्प 1800°C पर
options.B: CH4, H2, NH3, H2O वाष्प 800°C पर
options.C: CH4, CO2, H2, H2O वाष्प 1800°C पर
options.D: CH4, NH4, SO2, H2O वाष्प 800°C पर

options_english.A: CH3, O2, NH3, H2O vapour at 1800°C
options_english.B: CH4, H2, NH3, H2O vapour at 800°C
options_english.C: CH4, CO2, H2, H2O vapour at 1800°C
options_english.D: CH4, NH4, SO2, H2O vapour at 800°C

questions.solution: In 1953, S.L. Miller successfully created conditions in a laboratory scale mimicking the primitive earth to prove chemical evolution. He utilized a closed flask apparatus wherein he circulated a mixture of Methane (CH4), Hydrogen (H2), Ammonia (NH3), and water vapour at a high temperature of exactly 800 degrees Celsius and supplied energy through electric discharges.
questions.solution_hindi: 1953 में एस. एल. मिलर ने आदिम पृथ्वी जैसी परिस्थितियाँ प्रयोगशाला में उत्पन्न कीं। उन्होंने एक बंद फ्लास्क में 800°C तापमान पर मीथेन (CH4), अमोनिया (NH3), हाइड्रोजन (H2) और जल वाष्प के मिश्रण में विद्युत डिस्चार्ज किया।

questions.text: एक प्रयोग में ई. कोलाई को 14NH4Cl युक्त संवर्धन माध्यम में विकसित किया (14N नाइट्रोजन का हल्का समस्थानिक है) । उसके पश्चात् इसे नाइट्रोजन के भारी समस्थानिक (15N) युक्त संवर्धन माध्यम में 6 पीढ़ियों तक संवर्धित किया गया । 6 पीढ़ियों के बाद उनके डीएनए को निष्कर्षित किया गया तथा CsCl घनत्व प्रवणता पर अपकेन्द्रण द्वारा निष्कर्षित किया गया । CsCl घनत्व प्रवणता अपकेन्द्रण पर डीएनए के सही घनत्व (हल्का/संकरित/भारी) और पट्टियों के अनुपात की पहचान कीजिए ।
questions.text_english: In an experiment, E. coli is grown in a medium containing 14NH4Cl. (14N is the light isotope of Nitrogen) followed by growing it for six generations in a medium having heavy isotope of nitrogen (15N). After six generations, their DNA was extracted and subjected to CsCl density gradient centrifugation. Identify the correct density (Light/Hybrid/Heavy) and ratio of the bands of DNA in CsCl density gradient centrifugation.
questions.solution: The experiment starts with completely light DNA (14N-14N). When grown in a medium with a heavy isotope (15N) for 6 generations, the total number of DNA molecules formed is 2 raised to the power of 6, which equals 64. Because DNA replication is semi-conservative, the 2 original light strands serve as templates and form 2 hybrid DNA molecules (14N-15N). The remaining 62 DNA molecules will be completely heavy (15N-15N). The ratio of Hybrid to Heavy is therefore 2:62, which simplifies precisely to 1:31.
questions.solution_hindi: ई. कोलाई में पूरी तरह से हल्का डीएनए (14N-14N) है। भारी समस्थानिक (15N) वाले माध्यम में 6 पीढ़ियों तक वृद्धि करने पर, डीएनए अणुओं की कुल संख्या 2^6 = 64 होगी। अर्धसंरक्षी प्रतिकृतियन के कारण, 2 मूल हल्के रज्जुक 2 संकरित डीएनए (14N-15N) अणु बनाएंगे। शेष 62 डीएनए अणु पूरी तरह से भारी (15N-15N) होंगे। अतः संकरित : भारी का अनुपात 2:62 यानी 1:31 होगा।

questions.text: एक रोगी जिसको लगातार उच्च ताप (ज्वर) (39°C से 40°C), आमाशय (उदर) में पीड़ा, कब्ज़, सिरदर्द, भूख न लगना तथा कमजोरी के लक्षण परिलक्षित हो रहे हैं, वह किस रोग से पीड़ित है ?
questions.text_english: Which disease is the patient suffering from who is showing symptoms such as sustained high fever (39°C to 40°C), stomach pain, constipation, headache, loss of appetite and weakness?
questions.solution: The symptoms described—sustained high fever between 39°C and 40°C, stomach pain, persistent constipation, severe headache, loss of appetite, and extreme weakness—are the classic clinical indications of Typhoid fever. This infection is caused by the pathogenic bacterium Salmonella typhi.
questions.solution_hindi: दिए गए लक्षण जैसे कि लगातार उच्च ताप (39°C से 40°C), उदर में पीड़ा, कब्ज़, सिरदर्द और भूख न लगना टाइफॉइड (Typhoid) रोग के स्पष्ट लक्षण हैं, जो साल्मोनेला टाइफी नामक जीवाणु के संक्रमण के कारण होता है।

questions.text: स्टैनले कोहेन तथा हरबर्ट बोयर ने प्रथम पुनर्योगज डीएनए निर्मित करने के लिए किस सहज प्लाज्मिड का उपयोग किया था ?
questions.text_english: Which native plasmid did Stanley Cohen and Herbert Boyer use for the construction of the first recombinant DNA?
questions.solution: In 1972, Stanley Cohen and Herbert Boyer successfully constructed the first recombinant DNA molecule. To achieve this, they isolated the antibiotic resistance gene and linked it with the native plasmid of the bacterium Salmonella typhimurium, which acts as a vector.
questions.solution_hindi: स्टैनले कोहेन और हरबर्ट बोयर ने 1972 में प्रथम पुनर्योगज डीएनए का निर्माण साल्मोनेला टाइफीमूरियम (Salmonella typhimurium) नामक जीवाणु के सहज प्लाज्मिड का उपयोग करके किया था।

questions.text: PCR में डीएनए के प्रवर्धन के लिए निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा उपक्रामकों के तापानुशीलन को सही प्रकार से निरूपित करता है ?
questions.text_english: Which one of the following represents the correct annealing of primers to the DNA to be amplified in the PCR ?

options.A: Primers facing away from each other
options.B: Both primers on the same end
options.C: Primers binding to 3' ends and growing towards each other

options_english.A: Primers facing away from each other
options_english.B: Both primers on the same end
options_english.C: Primers binding to 3' ends and growing towards each other

questions.solution: During the annealing step of PCR, two sets of short primers bind specifically to the complementary sequences located at the 3' ends of both the separated template DNA strands. Because DNA polymerase extends from the 3' OH end, the primers must be oriented so they grow towards each other along the template.
questions.solution_hindi: पीसीआर (PCR) के तापानुशीलन (annealing) चरण के दौरान, उपक्रमक (प्राइमर्स) पृथक किए गए डीएनए टेम्पलेट रज्जुकों के 3' सिरे से जुड़ते हैं। चूँकि डीएनए पॉलीमरेज़ 5' से 3' दिशा में काम करता है, प्राइमर्स इस प्रकार जुड़ते हैं कि वे एक-दूसरे की ओर बढ़ते हुए डीएनए का संश्लेषण कर सकें।

questions.text: जब आवास में संसाधन सीमाकारी न (असीमित) हों, तो समष्टि की ज्यामितीय (ज्योमेट्रिकल) शैली में वृद्धि दर्शाने वाला समष्टि वृद्धि वक्र होगा :
questions.text_english: The population growth curve applicable for a population growing in a geometric fashion, when the resources are not limiting in the habitat will be:
questions.solution: When resources in a habitat are completely unlimited, each individual of the species reaches its maximum innate capacity to reproduce. The population experiences unrestricted exponential or geometric growth, resulting in a classic J-shaped curve when population density is plotted against time.
questions.solution_hindi: जब किसी आवास में संसाधन (भोजन और स्थान) असीमित होते हैं, तो समष्टि के सदस्य अपनी अधिकतम प्रजनन क्षमता का उपयोग करते हैं। इससे समष्टि में चरघातांकी (exponential) या ज्यामितीय वृद्धि होती है, जिसे ग्राफ पर निरूपित करने पर 'J' आकार का वक्र प्राप्त होता है।

questions.text:
अभिकथन (A): सुकेंद्रकियों में प्रारंभिक अनुलेख (प्रतिलिपि) से अव्यक्तेक को हटाने के लिए समबंधन (स्प्लाइसिंग) प्रक्रम से गुज़रना पड़ता है ।
कारण (R) : सुकेंद्रकियों में प्रारंभिक अनुलेख (प्रतिलिपि) में व्यक्तेक व अव्यक्तेक दोनों होते हैं तथा अव्यक्तेक अक्रिय होते हैं ।
questions.text_english:
Assertion (A): Primary transcripts in eukaryotes are subjected to splicing to remove the introns.
Reason (R): Primary transcripts contain both exons and introns and the introns are non-functional in eukaryotes.
questions.instruction_line: इन प्रश्नों के सही उत्तर नीचे दिए गए कोडों (A), (B), (C) और (D) में से चुनकर दीजिए ।
questions.instruction_line_english: Select the correct answer to these questions from the codes (A), (B), (C) and (D) as given below.

options.A: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सही हैं और कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या करता है ।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सही हैं, परन्तु कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सही है, परन्तु कारण (R) ग़लत है ।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) ग़लत है, परन्तु कारण (R) सही है ।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of the Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of the Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: The assertion is completely true. In eukaryotes, the freshly transcribed hnRNA (primary transcript) undergoes splicing to become mature mRNA. The reason correctly explains why this happens: the primary transcript contains both coding sequences (exons) and non-coding intervening sequences (introns). Since introns are entirely non-functional for protein synthesis, they must be meticulously removed.
questions.solution_hindi: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों पूरी तरह सत्य हैं और कारण सही व्याख्या कर रहा है। सुकेंद्रकियों में उत्पन्न प्रारंभिक अनुलेख (hnRNA) में कोडिंग (व्यक्तेक) और नॉन-कोडिंग (अव्यक्तेक) दोनों अनुक्रम होते हैं। चूँकि अव्यक्तेक (introns) अक्रिय होते हैं, इसलिए उन्हें स्प्लाइसिंग प्रक्रिया द्वारा हटा दिया जाता है।

questions.text:

questions.text_english: What is a vaccine? Write the basis on which it acts when administered in the body.

key_points: A vaccine is a biological preparation containing inactivated or weakened pathogens or antigenic proteins of a pathogen.
It acts on the principle of 'memory' of the immune system.
Upon administration, it generates primary immune response producing antibodies and memory B and T cells that protect against future natural infections.

questions.solution: A vaccine is a carefully formulated biological preparation consisting of antigenic proteins of pathogens, or inactivated/weakened pathogens themselves, designed to confer active acquired immunity against a specific disease. Once administered into the body, it acts fundamentally on the principle of the immune system's 'memory'. The vaccine mimics a natural infection without causing the disease, prompting the immune system to generate specific antibodies and long-lived memory B and T cells. If the actual live pathogen attempts to infect the body in the future, these memory cells instantly recognize the invader and launch a massive and rapid secondary immune response to neutralize it before the disease can develop.
questions.solution_hindi: वैक्सीन या टीका एक जैविक पदार्थ है जिसमें रोगजनक के प्रतिजनी (antigenic) प्रोटीन या निष्क्रिय/कमज़ोर किए गए रोगजनक होते हैं। वैक्सीन प्रतिरक्षा तंत्र की 'स्मृति' (memory) के सिद्धांत पर कार्य करती है। जब इसे शरीर में प्रविष्ट कराया जाता है, तो यह शरीर में रोग पैदा किए बिना प्राथमिक प्रतिरक्षा प्रतिक्रिया उत्पन्न करती है, जिससे विशिष्ट प्रतिपिंड (antibodies) और स्मृति B तथा T कोशिकाएँ बनती हैं। भविष्य में जब वास्तविक रोगजनक शरीर पर हमला करता है, तो ये स्मृति कोशिकाएँ तेजी से उसे पहचान कर नष्ट कर देती हैं।

questions.text:
m-RNA का एक काल्पनिक लघु खंड जो एक सक्रिय पॉलीपेप्टाइड श्रृंखला का कूट लेखन करता है, के दिए गए आँकड़े (डाटा) पर विचार कीजिए तथा आगे दिए गए प्रश्नों के उत्तर लिखिए :
mRNA 5′- UCAUUACCACGAUUCUUUAAAAGA - 3'
(क) यदि 5वें (पाँचवें) प्रकूट (कोडॉन) में 'U' के स्थान पर 'C' प्रतिस्थापित हो जाए, तो दिए गए प्रकूटों (कोडॉनों) से कितने ऐमीनो अम्ल बनेंगे ? अपने उत्तर की व्याख्या कीजिए ।
(ख) उपर्युक्त mRNA के समान mRNA में जहाँ चौथे प्रकूट (कोडॉन) में यदि 'C' के स्थान पर 'U' हो, तो संश्लेषित होने वाले पॉलीपेप्टाइड में ऐमीनो अम्लों की संख्या लिखिए । अपने उत्तर की न्यायसंगतता सिद्ध कीजिए ।
questions.text_english:
Consider the given data of a hypothetical small portion of mRNA that codes for a functional polypeptide chain and answer the questions that follow:
mRNA 5′- UCAUUACCACGAUUCUUUAAAAGA - 3'
(a) How many amino acids will be formed from the given codons, if substitution of 'U' by 'C' takes place at the 5th codon? Explain your answer.
(b) Write the number of amino acids that would be in the polypeptide synthesised by a similar mRNA as above, where in the fourth codon instead of 'C' there is 'U'. Justify your answer.

key_points: (a) 8 amino acids will be formed. The substitution does not create a stop codon.
(b) 3 amino acids will be formed. The fourth codon becomes UGA, which is a stop codon.

questions.solution:
(a) The given mRNA consists of exactly 8 consecutive triplet codons without any stop codon at the end. If the substitution of 'U' by 'C' occurs in the 5th codon (UUC), it transforms into CUC. Because CUC is a perfectly valid codon that specifies a standard amino acid, the translation process will continue unimpeded, resulting in a full polypeptide chain comprising exactly 8 amino acids.
(b) If the fourth codon (CGA) has its 'C' substituted by a 'U', the resulting sequence transforms into UGA. UGA serves as a universal 'Stop' or terminator codon during translation. Thus, the ribosome will immediately halt polypeptide synthesis at the fourth codon, prematurely releasing a truncated polypeptide chain consisting of only 3 amino acids.
questions.solution_hindi:
(क) दिए गए mRNA में कुल 8 कोडॉन हैं। यदि 5वें कोडॉन (UUC) में 'U' के स्थान पर 'C' प्रतिस्थापित होता है, तो नया कोडॉन CUC बनेगा। चूँकि यह कोई स्टॉप कोडॉन नहीं है, इसलिए स्थानांतरण (translation) की प्रक्रिया नहीं रुकेगी और पूरी श्रृंखला से ठीक 8 ऐमीनो अम्ल बनेंगे।
(ख) यदि चौथे कोडॉन (CGA) में 'C' के स्थान पर 'U' आ जाता है, तो यह UGA बन जाएगा। UGA एक समापक (Stop) कोडॉन है, जो स्थानांतरण प्रक्रिया को वहीं रोक देता है। इसलिए, इसके पहले के केवल 3 कोडॉन ही 3 ऐमीनो अम्ल वाली एक छोटी पॉलीपेप्टाइड श्रृंखला का निर्माण करेंगे।

(क) दो संयोजनों A तथा B में से किसमें आप डीएनए खंडों को पृथक हुआ देखेंगे तथा क्यों ? अपने उत्तर की न्यायसंगतता सिद्ध कीजिए ।
(ख) संयोजन-C में I तथा II में से कौन-सी पट्टी लंबे डीएनए खंडों वाली है। अपने उत्तर की न्यायसंगतता सिद्ध कीजिए ।
questions.text_english:
With reference to the set-ups (A, B and C) given below, of the electrophoretic separation of a mixture of DNA fragments of varied lengths, answer the questions that follow:
(a) In which one of the two Set-ups, A or B, would you see the DNA fragments separated and why? Justify your answer.
(b) In Set-up C, which one of the two, I/II, are the bands of longer fragments of DNA? Justify your answer.

key_points: (a) Set-up A. DNA fragments are negatively charged and move towards the positive electrode (anode).
(b) Band I. Longer fragments face more resistance from the agarose gel matrix and travel slower, staying closer to the well.

questions.solution:
(a) We would successfully see the DNA fragments separated in Set-up A. This is because DNA fragments are inherently negatively charged due to their phosphate groups. When placed under an electric field in gel electrophoresis, they must be loaded near the negative electrode (cathode) so they are strongly repelled and can migrate steadily towards the positive electrode (anode). In Set-up B, loading them at the anode would prevent any forward migration into the gel.
(b) In Set-up C, the bands grouped under region 'I' absolutely represent the longer fragments of DNA. According to the sieving effect of the agarose gel matrix, the rate of migration is inversely proportional to the size of the DNA fragment. Therefore, the bulkier, longer fragments face much more resistance, travel significantly slower, and remain positioned much closer to the loading well at the top compared to smaller fragments.
questions.solution_hindi:
(क) हम डीएनए खंडों का पृथक्करण 'संयोजन A' में देखेंगे। इसका कारण यह है कि डीएनए अणु ऋणात्मक रूप से आवेशित (negatively charged) होते हैं। जेल इलेक्ट्रोफोरेसिस में, उन्हें कैथोड (ऋणात्मक इलेक्ट्रोड) की ओर कूपों (wells) में डाला जाता है ताकि वे विद्युत क्षेत्र के प्रभाव में एनोड (धनात्मक इलेक्ट्रोड) की ओर आसानी से जा सकें।
(ख) 'संयोजन C' में पट्टी 'I' लंबे डीएनए खंडों का प्रतिनिधित्व करती है। एगारोज़ जेल में छनने (sieving) के प्रभाव के कारण, डीएनए खंड अपने आकार के अनुसार अलग होते हैं। बड़े और लंबे डीएनए खंड जेल में अधिक प्रतिरोध का सामना करते हैं, जिससे वे धीरे चलते हैं और कूपों के निकट ही रह जाते हैं।

sub_questions.solution: Humus is formed during the humification stage of the decomposition cycle in a terrestrial ecosystem. Due to its colloidal nature, it acts as an excellent, stable reservoir for retaining vital nutrients within the soil.

questions.text: सहायक जनन प्रौद्योगिकियों की आई यू आई (IUI) तथा आई यू टी (IUT) विधियों की व्याख्या कीजिए ।
questions.text_english: Explain the IUI and IUT methods of assisted reproductive technologies.

key_points: IUI (Intra-Uterine Insemination) involves artificially introducing collected semen directly into the uterus of the female to assist fertilization, commonly used when sperm count is low.
IUT (Intra-Uterine Transfer) is a step in IVF where embryos that have developed to more than 8 blastomeres are directly transferred into the uterus to complete further development.

questions.solution:
IUI and IUT are two distinct clinical procedures under Assisted Reproductive Technologies (ART). 
IUI stands for Intra-Uterine Insemination. In this highly effective procedure, healthy semen collected either from the husband or a matching healthy donor is artificially and directly injected into the uterus of the female. It is primarily recommended to treat infertility cases where the male partner suffers from an extremely low sperm count or inability to inseminate naturally.
IUT stands for Intra-Uterine Transfer. This procedure is generally utilized as an advanced step in the In-Vitro Fertilization (IVF) protocol. Following fertilization outside the body, when the developing embryo has successfully crossed the 8-blastomere stage, it is carefully transferred directly into the patient's uterus to undergo implantation and complete its natural development.
questions.solution_hindi:
IUI और IUT सहायक जनन प्रौद्योगिकियों (ART) की दो अलग-अलग विधियाँ हैं।
IUI (Intra-Uterine Insemination) का अर्थ है अंतः गर्भाशय वीर्यसेचन। इस प्रक्रिया में, पति या किसी स्वस्थ दाता से प्राप्त स्वस्थ वीर्य को कृत्रिम रूप से सीधे स्त्री के गर्भाशय में प्रवेश कराया जाता है। यह विधि उन मामलों में उपयोगी है जहाँ पुरुष साथी में शुक्राणुओं की संख्या बहुत कम होती है।
IUT (Intra-Uterine Transfer) का अर्थ है अंतः गर्भाशय स्थानांतरण। यह इन-विट्रो फर्टिलाइजेशन (IVF) का एक चरण है। शरीर के बाहर निषेचन के बाद, जब भ्रूण 8 ब्लास्टोमियर (कोरकखण्ड) की अवस्था से अधिक विकसित हो जाता है, तो उसे आगे के विकास और आरोपण के लिए सीधे माता के गर्भाशय में स्थानांतरित कर दिया जाता है।

questions.text_english:
Three crosses were carried out in pea plants with respect to flower colour violet/white (V/v) and flower position axial/terminal (A/a). Study in the table the crosses 'a', 'b' and 'c' where parental phenotypes and their F1 progeny phenotypes are given.

Parental plants (Phenotypes) | F1 Progeny (Phenotypes)
(a) Violet, axial × white, axial | 6/16 white, axial, 2/16 white, terminal, 6/16 violet, axial, 2/16 violet, terminal (actually the pdf says violet, axial twice, I will infer standard ratio)
(b) Violet, axial × white, terminal | 1/4 violet, axial, 1/4 violet, terminal, 1/4 white, axial, 1/4 white, terminal
(c) Violet, axial × violet, axial | 3/4 violet, axial, 1/4 white, axial

Find the genotypes of each of the parental pairs of crosses 'a', 'b' and 'c'.

key_points: Cross (a): VvAa x vvAa
Cross (b): VvAa x vvaa
Cross (c): VvAA x VvAA (or VvAa x VvAA depending on assumption, VvAA x VvAA yields 100% axial)

questions.solution:
To determine the parental genotypes, we must independently analyze the segregation of each trait in the F1 progeny.
For cross (a): The phenotype is Violet, axial × White, axial. The F1 progeny displays both Violet/White (1:1 ratio, meaning Vv × vv) and Axial/Terminal (3:1 ratio, meaning Aa × Aa). Therefore, the correct parental genotypes for cross (a) are VvAa and vvAa.
For cross (b): The phenotype is Violet, axial × White, terminal. The F1 progeny shows a perfect test cross ratio of 1:1:1:1 for all four phenotypic combinations. This indicates the Violet, axial parent is fully heterozygous for both traits, and the White, terminal parent is homozygous recessive. Therefore, the exact genotypes are VvAa and vvaa.
For cross (c): The phenotype is Violet, axial × Violet, axial. The F1 progeny shows segregation for flower colour (Violet to White is 3:1, indicating both parents are heterozygous Vv × Vv) but absolute uniformity for flower position (all are axial, meaning no recessive alleles combined, so at least one or both parents must be homozygous AA). Thus, the parental genotypes can be definitively stated as VvAA and VvAA (or VvAA and VvAa).
questions.solution_hindi:
पैतृक जीनोटाइप निर्धारित करने के लिए हम प्रत्येक लक्षण का अलग-अलग विश्लेषण करते हैं।
क्रॉस (a) के लिए: जनक बैंगनी, अक्षीय × सफेद, अक्षीय हैं। F1 में बैंगनी और सफेद का अनुपात 1:1 है (Vv × vv), जबकि अक्षीय और अंत्य का अनुपात 3:1 है (Aa × Aa)। अतः जनकों का जीनोटाइप VvAa और vvAa होगा।
क्रॉस (b) के लिए: जनक बैंगनी, अक्षीय × सफेद, अंत्य हैं। F1 में सभी चारों फीनोटाइप 1:1:1:1 के अनुपात में मिलते हैं। यह एक द्विसंकर परीक्षार्थ संकरण (dihybrid test cross) है। अतः जनकों का जीनोटाइप VvAa और vvaa होगा।
क्रॉस (c) के लिए: जनक बैंगनी, अक्षीय × बैंगनी, अक्षीय हैं। F1 में रंग का अनुपात 3:1 है (Vv × Vv), लेकिन स्थिति सभी की अक्षीय है, जिसका अर्थ है कि 'A' के लिए कम से कम एक जनक समयुग्मजी (AA) है। अतः संभावित जीनोटाइप VvAA और VvAA (या VvAa और VvAA) होगा।

questions.text_english:
A population of snakes lived in a desert with brown sand. Study the drawings given below showing the change in the population from 'one' to 'two' over time and answer the question that follows. Brown snakes and Grey snakes are represented by alleles A/a (Dominant/recessive).
(a) If the frequency of the recessive trait is 9% in population-one, work out the frequency of homozygous dominant and heterozygous dominant snakes.
(b) Name the mechanism of evolution that must have operated so that population-two evolved from population-one.

key_points: (a) Recessive trait (q^2) = 0.09. So q = 0.3. p = 1 - 0.3 = 0.7. Homozygous dominant (p^2) = 0.49 or 49%. Heterozygous dominant (2pq) = 2(0.7)(0.3) = 0.42 or 42%.
(b) Natural Selection (specifically directional selection caused by predation from migrating birds).

questions.solution:
(a) According to the Hardy-Weinberg equilibrium equation, the frequency of the recessive trait (grey snakes, genotype aa) is represented by q² = 9% or 0.09. Therefore, the frequency of the recessive allele 'a' (q) is the square root of 0.09, which is 0.3. 
Since p + q = 1, the frequency of the dominant allele 'A' (p) is 1 - 0.3 = 0.7.
The frequency of homozygous dominant snakes (AA) is p² = (0.7)² = 0.49, or 49%.
The frequency of heterozygous dominant snakes (Aa) is 2pq = 2 * (0.7) * (0.3) = 0.42, or 42%.
(b) The precise evolutionary mechanism observed operating from population-one to population-two is Natural Selection. The migratory birds act as a strong selective pressure by visually preying on the more conspicuous grey snakes, actively leaving the better-camouflaged brown snakes to survive and freely reproduce.
questions.solution_hindi:
(क) हार्डी-वेनबर्ग सिद्धांत के अनुसार, अप्रभावी विशेषक (aa) की आवृत्ति q² = 9% या 0.09 है। अतः अप्रभावी एलील (q) की आवृत्ति = √0.09 = 0.3 होगी।
सूत्र p + q = 1 के अनुसार, प्रभावी एलील (p) की आवृत्ति = 1 - 0.3 = 0.7 होगी।
समयुग्मजी प्रभावी साँपों (AA) की आवृत्ति p² = (0.7)² = 0.49 या 49% होगी।
विषमयुग्मजी प्रभावी साँपों (Aa) की आवृत्ति 2pq = 2 × 0.7 × 0.3 = 0.42 या 42% होगी।
(ख) समष्टि-एक से समष्टि-दो के विकास का मुख्य कारण 'प्राकृतिक वरण' (Natural Selection) है। चित्र में प्रवासी पक्षी शिकारियों के रूप में दिखाई दे रहे हैं, जो स्पष्ट दिखने वाले धूसर साँपों का शिकार कर लेते हैं, जिससे वातावरण के अनुकूल भूरे साँप बच जाते हैं।

(i) List two major reasons for using cow-dung in a biogas plant instead of using domestic sewage.
(ii) Mention one use of the unspent slurry of the biogas plant.

key_points: (i) Cow dung naturally contains a very high concentration of methanogenic bacteria (methanogens) derived from the rumen of cattle, which are essential for biogas production. Cow dung is also very rich in cellulosic material which is the primary substrate.
(ii) The unspent slurry is highly nutrient-rich and is widely used as a natural, organic fertilizer for crops.

sub_questions.solution:
(i) There are two major reasons for preferring cow-dung over domestic sewage in a biogas plant. First, cow-dung is naturally extremely rich in cellulosic organic matter, providing a steady and excellent substrate. Second, it already contains an immensely high concentration of crucial methanogenic bacteria (like Methanobacterium) sourced naturally from the rumen (stomach) of the cattle, which are strictly required for the anaerobic breakdown that produces methane gas.
(ii) The unspent, residual slurry left behind in the biogas plant is heavily concentrated with nitrogen and phosphorus. Therefore, it is extracted and effectively utilized by farmers as a high-quality, eco-friendly organic fertilizer to dramatically enrich soil quality and enhance crop yields.

questions.text_english:
(a) Give the scientific name of the bacteria widely used in biotechnology to create a GM cotton crop resistant to bollworm attacks.
(b) Explain how GM cotton crop is able to resist insect attacks.

key_points: (a) Bacillus thuringiensis.
(b) The GM cotton expresses the 'cry' genes (cryIAc, cryIIAb) which produce inactive toxic protein crystals.
When the bollworm ingests the plant tissue, the alkaline pH of its gut solubilizes the crystals, converting them into active toxins.
The active toxin firmly binds to the midgut epithelial cells, creating pores, causing swelling, lysis, and ultimately the death of the insect.

questions.solution:
(a) The scientific name of the beneficial soil bacterium widely utilized in modern biotechnology to create bollworm-resistant Genetically Modified (GM) cotton is Bacillus thuringiensis.
(b) The GM cotton crop (commonly known as Bt Cotton) successfully resists catastrophic insect attacks by heavily relying on specific genes (like cryIAc and cryIIAb) isolated from the Bacillus thuringiensis bacteria. These specialized genes are incorporated into the plant's genome, prompting the plant tissues to constantly produce highly specific insecticidal protein crystals. Inside the plant, these toxic proteins remain in a completely inactive protoxin state. However, when an attacking bollworm ingests the plant's tissues, the highly alkaline pH environment inside the insect's gut rapidly solubilizes the crystals, instantly converting the protoxin into an active deadly toxin. This newly activated toxin firmly binds to the surface of the midgut epithelial cells of the insect, rapidly creating massive pores. This devastating cellular disruption causes violent swelling and massive cell lysis, leading to the immediate starvation and subsequent death of the attacking pest.

questions.text_english: Describe how fig tree and wasp relationship is a spectacular example of mutualism.

key_points: Mutualism is an ecological interaction where both interacting species derive benefit.
The female wasp uses the fig fruit solely as an oviposition (egg-laying) site and utilizes the developing seeds within the fruit to deeply nourish its larvae.
In return, while searching for appropriate egg-laying sites within the inflorescence, the wasp inadvertently yet highly efficiently pollinates the fig flowers, ensuring the tree's reproduction.

questions.solution:
Mutualism is an essential ecological interaction where both participating species derive a significant survival benefit. The highly evolved relationship between the fig tree and its specific pollinator wasp species stands as a spectacular example of obligate mutualism. 
The female wasp fundamentally relies on the fig tree for reproduction. She uses the specialized fig fruit (syconium) as a safe oviposition site to comfortably lay her eggs. Furthermore, she heavily utilizes the nutrient-rich developing seeds inside the fig to feed her growing larvae. 
In direct exchange for these critical nesting and nourishment services, the wasp provides an irreplaceable service to the tree. While she vigorously crawls around inside the fig inflorescence searching for optimal spots to lay her eggs, she invariably brushes against the mature anthers and effectively transfers pollen to the stigmas, accomplishing highly specific and guaranteed pollination for the fig tree. Neither species can complete its life cycle without the other.

questions.text_english: Answer any one of the following:

sub_questions.text:
(i) परपरागण को प्रोत्साहित करने हेतु पुष्पी पौधों द्वारा विकसित किन्हीं चार युक्तियों की व्याख्या कीजिए ।
(ii) पौधे स्वपरागण को हतोत्साहित क्यों करते हैं ? कोई एक कारण लिखिए ।
sub_questions.text_english:
(i) Explain any four devices that flowering plants have developed to encourage cross-pollination.
(ii) Why do plants discourage self-pollination? State any one reason.

key_points: (i) Dichogamy: Pollen release and stigma receptivity are not synchronized.
(i) Herkogamy: Physical barriers exist between the anther and stigma.
(i) Self-incompatibility: A genetic mechanism that prevents self-pollen from germinating or growing down the style.
(i) Dicliny (Unisexuality): Production of strictly unisexual flowers (male and female flowers on different plants).
(ii) Continuous self-pollination eventually leads to inbreeding depression, lowering the evolutionary fitness and vigour of the resulting offspring.

sub_questions.solution:
(i) To aggressively encourage cross-pollination, flowering plants have naturally evolved several ingenious outbreeding devices. Firstly, Dichogamy ensures that pollen release and stigma receptivity are deliberately not synchronized; the anther may mature much earlier than the stigma, or vice versa, preventing autogamy. Secondly, Herkogamy involves specific morphological adaptations where the anther and stigma are placed at drastically different positions or separated by physical barriers, making self-contact impossible. Thirdly, Self-incompatibility serves as a sophisticated genetic mechanism wherein the pistil actively rejects pollen from the exact same plant, stopping pollen tube growth in the style. Lastly, Dicliny involves the plant entirely abandoning hermaphroditism by producing exclusively unisexual flowers, ensuring that outcrossing is the absolute only reproductive option.
(ii) Plants biologically discourage self-pollination primarily because continuous, multi-generational self-pollination severely reduces genetic diversity. This lack of variation eventually leads to a highly detrimental biological phenomenon known as inbreeding depression, which dangerously lowers the overall survival fitness, yield, and evolutionary vigour of the plant's offspring.

एक सामान्य मानव स्त्री के आर्तव चक्र की अंडाशयी तथा गर्भाशयी प्रावस्थाओं की व्याख्या पीयूष तथा अंडाशयी हॉर्मोनों की भूमिका के साथ निम्नलिखित प्रावस्थाओं के अंतर्गत कीजिए :

(ii) स्रावी प्रावस्था
(iii) आर्तव प्रावस्था
sub_questions.text_english:
Explain the ovarian and uterine events taking place along with the role of pituitary and ovarian hormones, during menstrual cycle in a normal human female under the following phases:
(i) Follicular phase/proliferative phase
(ii) Luteal phase/secretory phase
(iii) Menstrual phase

key_points: Follicular phase: Pituitary FSH and LH stimulate primary follicles to mature into Graafian follicles. Growing follicles secrete estrogen, which proliferates the uterine endometrium.

Luteal phase: Following ovulation (caused by LH surge), the ruptured follicle turns into the corpus luteum, which secretes massive amounts of progesterone to thicken and maintain the secretory endometrium for possible implantation.

Menstrual phase: If no fertilization occurs, the corpus luteum degenerates, severely dropping progesterone and estrogen levels. This causes the thickened endometrium to break down and shed as menstrual flow.

sub_questions.solution:
The menstrual cycle in a healthy human female is a highly orchestrated interplay of ovarian and uterine events, driven entirely by pituitary and ovarian hormones.
(i) Follicular phase (Proliferative phase): During this stage, the gradual increase in pituitary gonadotropins (FSH and LH) directly stimulates primary ovarian follicles to grow and mature into a fully developed Graafian follicle. Simultaneously, these growing follicles actively secrete the ovarian hormone estrogen. Surging estrogen levels command the highly vascularized endometrium of the uterus to proliferate and rapidly regenerate itself.
(ii) Luteal phase (Secretory phase): Triggered by a massive LH surge around day 14, ovulation occurs. The remaining ruptured Graafian follicle transforms into a temporary endocrine structure called the corpus luteum. The corpus luteum immediately begins secreting massive quantities of progesterone. Progesterone is utterly essential during this phase as it heavily thickens and robustly maintains the highly secretory endometrial lining, preparing it for the potential implantation of a fertilized ovum.
(iii) Menstrual phase: If fertilization fails to occur, the unutilized corpus luteum inevitably degenerates. Consequently, the bodily levels of progesterone and estrogen plummet drastically. Deprived of hormonal support, the heavily thickened uterine endometrium collapses and breaks down, shedding its blood vessels and tissues out through the vagina as menstrual flow, thus marking the start of a new cycle.

questions.text_english: Answer any one of the following:

sub_questions.text: “विषमयुग्मजी अवस्था में दोनों एलीलों के प्रभाव की स्पष्ट अभिव्यक्ति सहप्रभाविता (कोडोमिनेंस) में परिलक्षित होती है ।” मानव रुधिर वर्ग ABO की वंशागति की सहायता से कथन की व्याख्या कीजिए ।
sub_questions.text_english: "The influence of both the alleles in a heterozygous state is clearly expressed in codominance." Explain with the help of inheritance of ABO blood group in humans.

key_points: Codominance is a genetic phenomenon where both alleles in a heterozygote fully express themselves simultaneously without blending.
ABO blood grouping is controlled by the I gene, which has three distinct alleles: IA, IB, and i.
Alleles IA and IB produce slightly different forms of sugar polymers on the RBC surface, whereas allele i does not produce any.
When a person inherits both IA and IB alleles (genotype IAIB), both alleles express their respective sugars fully.
As a result, the RBCs have both A and B types of sugars, determining the individual's blood group as AB, which is a perfect textbook example of codominance.

sub_questions.solution:
Codominance is a unique genetic phenomenon where two distinct alleles of a single gene, when present together in a heterozygous condition, do not exhibit a dominant-recessive relationship but instead express themselves fully and independently. 
The inheritance of the ABO blood group in humans serves as a spectacular example to explain this. The ABO blood groups are rigorously controlled by the 'I' gene, which possesses three multiple alleles: IA, IB, and i. The functional alleles IA and IB direct the synthesis of slightly different forms of antigenic sugar polymers on the plasma membrane of red blood cells (RBCs), whereas the recessive 'i' allele fails to produce any functional sugar. 
When a human offspring inherits the IA allele from one parent and the IB allele from the other parent, their genetic makeup becomes the heterozygous IAIB. In this specific scenario, neither allele masks the other. Instead, because of codominance, both the IA and IB alleles perfectly express their own specific sugars simultaneously. Consequently, the surface of the individual's RBCs gets coated with both A and B types of sugars, resulting in the distinct 'AB' blood group phenotype. This unequivocally proves that both alleles clearly express their individual influences without any blending.

sub_questions.text_english:
"A group of genes are regulated and expressed together as a unit in lac operon."
(i) Explain the mechanism of switching 'on' of the structural genes of lac operon.
(ii) "Regulation of lac operon' is referred to be negatively regulated." Justify giving a reason.

key_points: (i) Lactose acts as an inducer. When lactose is present, it physically binds to the repressor protein produced by the i-gene.
This binding alters the shape of the repressor, making it inactive and preventing it from binding to the operator region.
RNA polymerase then freely binds to the promoter and transcribes the structural genes (z, y, a) into lac mRNA.
(ii) It is termed 'negatively regulated' because the operon is fundamentally kept in a suppressed (switched off) state by the active repressor protein continuously produced by the regulatory gene.

sub_questions.solution:
(i) The lac operon is an inducible operon that remains switched off under normal conditions. It is successfully switched 'on' only when its substrate, lactose (or allolactose), is introduced into the bacterial medium. Lactose acts as an inducer. Inside the cell, the regulatory i-gene continuously synthesizes an active repressor protein. The inducer (lactose) physically binds to this active repressor protein, causing a conformational change that renders the repressor entirely inactive. Because the repressor is now disabled, it completely fails to bind to the specific operator region of the operon. With the operator site clear, the RNA polymerase enzyme can easily bind to the promoter site and smoothly initiate the transcription of the three downstream structural genes (z, y, and a) into a single polycistronic mRNA, effectively switching 'on' the operon.
(ii) The physiological regulation of the lac operon by the repressor protein is rigorously referred to as 'negative regulation'. This specific terminology is thoroughly justified because the natural, default state of the repressor protein is actively inhibitory. The repressor continuously binds to the operator sequence and creates a physical blockade, thereby strongly preventing RNA polymerase from transcribing the operon. Thus, the primary control mechanism heavily relies on actively 'stopping' or repressing gene expression.

sub_questions.text_english:
(i) Describe the life cycle of Plasmodium from the time it enters the human body till a female Anopheles mosquito bites an infected person.
(ii) Mention the two events of Plasmodium life cycle that occur within the female Anopheles body.

key_points: (i) Plasmodium enters the human body as sporozoites through mosquito bites. They reach the liver, multiply asexually, and burst liver cells.
They then attack Red Blood Cells (RBCs), multiply asexually, and repeatedly rupture RBCs, releasing toxic haemozoin.
Some parasites differentiate into sexual stages (male and female gametocytes) inside the RBCs.
(ii) Inside the mosquito: Fertilization and development occur in the mosquito's gut.
Mature, infective sporozoites subsequently migrate to and are stored in the mosquito's salivary glands.

sub_questions.solution:
(i) The complex life cycle of the malaria parasite Plasmodium begins when an infected female Anopheles mosquito bites a healthy human, directly injecting the infective forms called sporozoites into the bloodstream. These sporozoites swiftly travel to the liver, where they aggressively multiply asexually inside the liver cells. Eventually, the bloated liver cells burst, releasing the parasites back into the blood. The parasites then relentlessly attack the Red Blood Cells (RBCs), where they again multiply asexually, causing a vicious cycle of RBC rupture. The continuous rupturing of RBCs releases a highly toxic substance called haemozoin, which triggers the characteristic recurring chills and high fever. Eventually, some of these multiplying parasites inside the RBCs cease asexual division and deliberately differentiate into sexual stages, developing into mature male and female gametocytes. The parasite remains in this gametocyte stage in the human blood until another female Anopheles mosquito bites the infected person and ingests them during a blood meal.
(ii) Following the ingestion of the gametocytes, two critical events occur exclusively within the body of the female Anopheles mosquito. First, the male and female gametes fuse (fertilization) and undergo further development entirely within the mosquito's intestinal gut. Second, the resulting mature, infective sporozoites actively migrate away from the gut and take up residence in the mosquito's salivary glands, patiently waiting to be injected into a new human host.

sub_questions.text_english:
(i) Write two differences between malignant tumor and benign tumor.
(ii) Explain any three diagnostic techniques for the detection of cancer.

key_points: (i) Benign tumors remain confined to their original location, whereas malignant tumors exhibit metastasis, aggressively invading and spreading to surrounding healthy tissues.
Benign tumors grow relatively slowly and cause little damage, while malignant tumors grow rapidly and are extremely lethal.
(ii) Biopsy and Histopathological studies: A small tissue sample is physically excised, stained, and examined under a microscope by a pathologist to identify cancerous cells.
Radiography (X-rays) or CT scans: Uses X-rays to generate 2D or 3D images of the internal organs to detect abnormal masses.
Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI): Utilizes strong magnetic fields and non-ionizing radiation to highly accurately detect deep pathological and physiological tissue changes.

sub_questions.solution:
(i) The two primary differences between a benign tumor and a malignant tumor are as follows. Firstly, a benign tumor generally remains strictly confined to its original location in the body, whereas a malignant tumor inherently exhibits a dangerous property called metastasis, aggressively spreading to distant sites via blood and establishing new tumors. Secondly, a benign tumor grows relatively slowly and causes only localized, minimal damage to the body, whereas a malignant tumor grows incredibly rapidly, invades and destroys surrounding healthy tissues, and proves highly lethal by violently starving normal cells of their essential nutrients.
(ii) The early and accurate detection of cancer relies on several highly advanced diagnostic techniques. Three prominent methods include:
1. Biopsy and Histopathological studies: In this highly reliable physical procedure, a small piece of the suspected tissue is surgically extracted, thinly sectioned, chemically stained, and meticulously examined under a high-power microscope by an expert pathologist to identify abnormal cell division patterns.
2. Computed Tomography (CT) Scans: This advanced radiological technique uses multiple precise X-rays to instantly generate a detailed, computer-rendered three-dimensional image of the internal organs, easily highlighting the exact location and size of any hidden abnormal tissue masses.
3. Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI): This extremely safe and highly sophisticated technique utilizes powerful magnetic fields and non-ionizing radio frequencies. It is exceptionally accurate at actively detecting both pathological and minute physiological changes within deep living tissues without exposing the patient to harmful radiation.
